<!--
  Doosan M400 5CSA parameters. Groups / labels / Min / Max follow the Logos
  Conf/Parameter/100.xml; every address and Variant (scale) comes from the firmware
  (Prm_pcs.c PRM_PCS_TABLE 521 rows, Modbus232.c GetParamChannelIdx page map).
  Addr = zero-based holding register: 42001 = 2000 (page map) and
  43501 = 3500 = PRM_PCS[Q_CTRL_OPTION + offset] (GRP_PARAMETER_EX).
  Unit column = Logos unit | firmware enum name | firmware default.
  The last group lists every reachable firmware parameter in address order,
  including the ones the Logos 100.xml does not show.
-->

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!--
  M400 5CSA control panel. Addresses from Modbus232.c writeRegData (43001 = 3000):
    3000 = PCS command (MF_PCS_Command)
    3001 = test command (MF_TestCmd) - effective only with CTRL_TEST_MODE 1/2/10;
           PEBB ON/OFF also needs SYS_MO_ENABLE = 0 or a test mode
    3002 = PPC control word (MF_PCS_Control) - rewrites every flag bit on each write
    3005 = PEBB fan speed (test mode or fan override), 3007 = IDLE FS ON count
    3063 = Q_CTRL_OPTION, 3064/3065 = remote P/Q reference (raw, no range check)
  Logos labels 43002 "Security number" / 43004 / 43005 do not match this firmware;
  history / trace requests are 43101 / 43102 (protocols block).
-->
<controls>
  <group title="PCS Command">
    <cmd label="System ON"   addr="3000" value="1" color="success"/>
    <cmd label="System OFF"  addr="3000" value="2" color="warning" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="Fault Reset" addr="3000" value="3"/>
    <cmd label="MVP Power Clear" addr="3000" value="11"/>
    <cmd label="Reboot (TEST / SHUTDOWN / INIT)" addr="3000" value="8" color="danger" confirm="true"/>
  </group>
  <group title="Derating / Fan">
    <cmd label="Derating ON"  addr="3000" value="90"/>
    <cmd label="Derating OFF" addr="3000" value="91"/>
    <cmd label="PEBB Fan Enable ON"  addr="3000" value="101"/>
    <cmd label="PEBB Fan Enable OFF" addr="3000" value="102" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="Fan Override ON"  addr="3000" value="104"/>
    <cmd label="Fan Override OFF" addr="3000" value="105"/>
    <input label="PEBB Fan Speed" addr="3005" min="0" max="100" scale="1" decimals="0" default="0" confirm="true"/>
  </group>
  <group title="Remote References">
    <input label="Remote P Ref" addr="3064" unit="kW" min="-3276.8" max="3276.7" scale="10" decimals="1" signed="true" valueType="int16" default="0" confirm="true"/>
    <input label="Remote Q Ref" addr="3065" unit="kvar" min="-3276.8" max="3276.7" scale="10" decimals="1" signed="true" valueType="int16" default="0" confirm="true"/>
    <input label="Q Control Option (0 X / 1 SPFind / 2 SPFcap / 3 Q(V))" addr="3063" min="0" max="3" scale="1" decimals="0" default="0" confirm="true"/>
  </group>
  <group title="Test Mode">
    <cmd label="Test Mode ON (SHUTDOWN only)" addr="3000" value="9" color="warning" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="Test Mode OFF" addr="3000" value="10"/>
    <cmd label="Test Run ON"   addr="3001" value="15" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="Test Run OFF"  addr="3001" value="16"/>
    <cmd label="CB3 ON"    addr="3001" value="3" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="CB3 OFF"   addr="3001" value="4"/>
    <cmd label="CB3 TRIP"  addr="3001" value="5" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="CB3 RESET" addr="3001" value="6"/>
    <cmd label="GB ON"     addr="3001" value="11" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="GB OFF"    addr="3001" value="12"/>
    <cmd label="LB ON"     addr="3001" value="13" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="LB OFF"    addr="3001" value="14"/>
    <cmd label="GB_TRIP out CLOSE" addr="3001" value="1" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="GB_TRIP out OPEN"  addr="3001" value="2"/>
    <cmd label="Init-charge MC CLOSE" addr="3001" value="7" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="Init-charge MC OPEN"  addr="3001" value="8"/>
    <cmd label="PEBB Fan out CLOSE" addr="3001" value="9"/>
    <cmd label="PEBB Fan out OPEN"  addr="3001" value="10"/>
    <cmd label="ATS1 CLOSE" addr="3001" value="17" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="ATS1 OPEN"  addr="3001" value="18"/>
    <cmd label="ATS2 CLOSE" addr="3001" value="19" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="ATS2 OPEN"  addr="3001" value="20"/>
  </group>
  <group title="Test: Fast Switch">
    <cmd label="FS1 ON"  addr="3001" value="71" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="FS1 OFF" addr="3001" value="81"/>
    <cmd label="FS2 ON"  addr="3001" value="72" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="FS2 OFF" addr="3001" value="82"/>
    <cmd label="FS3 ON"  addr="3001" value="73" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="FS3 OFF" addr="3001" value="83"/>
    <cmd label="FS4 ON"  addr="3001" value="74" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="FS4 OFF" addr="3001" value="84"/>
    <cmd label="FS5 ON"  addr="3001" value="75" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="FS5 OFF" addr="3001" value="85"/>
    <cmd label="FS6 ON"  addr="3001" value="76" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="FS6 OFF" addr="3001" value="86"/>
  </group>
  <group title="Test: PEBB (SYS_MO_ENABLE = 0 or test mode)">
    <cmd label="PEBB1 ON"  addr="3001" value="21" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="PEBB1 OFF" addr="3001" value="35"/>
    <cmd label="PEBB2 ON"  addr="3001" value="22" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="PEBB2 OFF" addr="3001" value="36"/>
    <cmd label="PEBB3 ON"  addr="3001" value="23" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="PEBB3 OFF" addr="3001" value="37"/>
  </group>
  <group title="PPC Control Word">
    <!-- bit0 PV140, bit1 PV160, bit2 PV150, bit3 PV200, bit4 CMD_GC, bit5 CMD_GI,
         bit6 Shutdown, bit8 CTRL_TEST_MODE, bit10 Fault Reset. Every write sets ALL
         of these flags (cleared bits clear the flag). -->
    <input label="PPC Control (bitmask)" addr="3002" min="0" max="65535" scale="1" decimals="0" default="0" confirm="true"/>
  </group>
  <group title="Trace Capture">
    <cmd label="Trace Stop"    addr="3000" value="6"/>
    <cmd label="Trace Restart" addr="3000" value="7" color="success"/>
  </group>
  <group title="Maintenance (CTRL_TEST_MODE = 5)">
    <cmd label="Param Factory Reset + Reboot" addr="3000" value="4" color="danger" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="History Clear" addr="3000" value="5" color="danger" confirm="true"/>
  </group>
</controls>
